items.quote: Cyth drove an ethics review of conflict-of-interest declarations for the whole division.
He took ownership of the innovation lab's experiments on service design and steered it to completion.
Cyth Osford set the direction for the shift to a new way of working after two branches were combined across the public service.
Cyth took ownership of user research with residents on the new app and steered it to completion.
He headed process improvement in licensing operations, setting priorities for several teams.
He spearheaded dashboards tracking service performance metrics at the national level.
